notes.title: Solution for playing with old saved games prior to the free 2016 season update
notes.content:
If you still wish to play the previous version of the game using your old saved games, then we have now have made the following solution:-
- Open Steam Library
- Right click Rugby Union Team Manager 2015 and select Properties
- Select the Betas tab from the box which opens
- Enter access code BeforeUpdate and click Check Code
- Now fully close Steam from the taskbar
- Re-Open Steam Library
- Right click Rugby Union Team Manager 2015 and select Properties
- Select the Betas tab from the box which opens
- Now open the drop down menu and beforeupdate should be an option
- Select beforeupdate and the old build will begin to download
- When you've finished with the old build, and now want to play a fresh with the new 2016 season update, select NONE from the drop down menu.

I hope this is helpful

notes.title: Rugby Union Team Manager 2015 l'actualisation pour la saison 2015/2016
notes.content:
Comme promis, pour vous remercier tous de nous avoir soutenus avec « Rugby Union Team Manager 2015 », l'actualisation pour la saison 2015/2016 de toutes les équipes sous licence sera gratuite. Elle sera disponible sous forme de mise à jour via Steam le lundi 14 décembre. 

Veuillez cependant remarquer que si vous installez cette mise à jour, toute sauvegarde pré-existante ne fonctionnera plus : nous vous conseillons donc de finir ces parties durant le week-end. 

Une fois encore, un grand merci pour votre soutien. 

Nous vous souhaitons un bon Noël et une excellente nouvelle année.

notes.title: Free 2016 season update
notes.content:
As promised, and as a thank you, to all of you that have supported us with "Rugby Union Team Manager 2015"; there will be free 2015/2016 season update for all the licensed teams, this will be made available as an update via Steam on Monday the 14th of December.

 Please note though, that when you install this update, any previously saved games you have will no longer work, so you may wish to play a few of these out over the weekend.

 Once again many thanks for all your support.

 Have a super Christmas,and a great New Year

notes.content:
We will be adding another new extra feature to the game "The Nations Cup", to celebrate international Rugby. This will be a game on its own, accessed via the game's Start-up screen. It will be a free extra, to thank you all for your support of the game. This will go live via an update on Thursday 13th August.
We then intend to do a further free update to RUTM15, after the World Cup, with all the player movements for the licensed leagues, again as a thank you to all the Rugby fans who have supported of  Rugby Union Team Manager 2015.

Many Thanks

notes.title: Game Improvements
notes.content:
- Increased the number of ruck turnovers

- The user team now when returning a punt,,will run the ball back

- Penalties can be awarded to dominant scrum

- Ruck penalties can be awarded for not releasing ball and not rolling away

- Basic Backs B move no longer automatically runs through the gap at the scrum

- At 80 mins, only kick the ball dead if winning and also if you're in your own half

- Match continues at 40 mins and 80 mins if selecting a scrum or tap from a penalty

notes.title: French Language Version Update Now Available!
notes.content:
French fans can now enjoy a dedicated version of the game.

Select English or French on startup to play in French or English.

This update also includes the following:-

French guide and manual.

Players health no longer resets at the end of a season, injuries now carried over

Players training bonus no longer resets at the end of a season, +/- bonus now carried over

Some South Africa clubs names changed on the advise of a customer
 
Players promoted from the colts now have a name on international screens
 
International and World Class players promoted from the Academy now have a star

Venue maximum length increased to 22 characters in the editor
